safety.title: Crash test safety
safety.unavailable: Safety ratings aren't available right now.
safety.none: No NHTSA rating found — this US-market database rarely covers EU/JDM-spec or Soviet-era vehicles.
safety.source: Source: NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings (USA) — matched by make/model/year, US-spec trims only.
safety.brandsInfoIntro: NHTSA only tests vehicles sold new in the US, matched by exact make/model/year — not every model or year of a covered brand has a rating on file.
safety.brandsInfoDiscontinued: Discontinued in the US (older model years only)
safety.brandsInfoUncovered: Never sold in the US — no rating will ever exist, e.g.
safety.ratingsInfoStars: 1–5 stars, more stars = safer. "Not Rated" means NHTSA never tested that specific trim.
safety.ratingsInfoOverall: Overall: a combined score across all frontal, side, and rollover tests below.
safety.ratingsInfoFront: Front: driver/passenger protection in a 35 mph frontal crash into a fixed barrier.
safety.ratingsInfoSide: Side: occupant protection in a 38 mph side impact, plus a separate side pole impact test.
safety.ratingsInfoAverage: Average: when a make/model/year has several tested trims (body style, drivetrain), this is the mean across all of them, shown above the individual breakdown.
safety.ratingsInfoRollover: Rollover: risk of a rollover in a single-vehicle loss-of-control event — more stars = lower risk.
safety.ratingsInfoSidePole: Side pole: a separate, more severe side-impact test against a narrow pole (like a tree or post).
safety.ratingsInfoRolloverRisk: Rollover risk %: the actual estimated probability of a rollover, behind the star rating — plus the dynamic test result (e.g. "No Tip") from a real avoidance-maneuver test.
safety.ratingsInfoEquipment: ESC/FCW/LDW: whether stability control, forward-collision warning, and lane-departure warning came standard, optional, or weren't offered on this trim.
safety.ratingsInfoCombinedSideBarrier: Side barrier (combined): an older/secondary side-impact sub-score alongside the main Side and Side pole ratings above.
safety.ratingsInfoComplaints: Complaints/recalls: lifetime counts reported to NHTSA for this vehicle — not part of the crash test itself.
safety.ratingsInfoInvestigations: Investigations: open or closed NHTSA safety investigations into this vehicle.
safety.videoLoading: Preparing video — the original NHTSA clip is being converted to a playable format, this can take a moment the first time…
about.heading: About
about.body: This app shows vehicle data from the Ukrainian state open-data portal data.gov.ua, maintained by the Ministry of Internal Affairs. Data is updated monthly.
about.vinBody: VIN decoding is done with the free NHTSA (USA) API.
